messages:
Ana R: Quick standup — need final hero + 2 bullets for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages. Tie to launch posts, webinar banner, and inbound routing. EOD tomorrow?

Devin L: I can draft. Hosted focus = time-to-value, Dedicated = throughput predictability, Private = data control. Uploaded 3 sample heroes to the doc.

Sam K: For the webinar, propose a slim banner across all pages: 'Launch webinar — choose Hosted/Dedicated/Private track' -> one-click register + deployment dropdown. Less is more.

Priya M: Add hidden utm_campaign on the form and a deployment dropdown. That feeds routing tags. Also short benchmark blurb for the hero area (<=160 chars).

Chris H: Bench permalink: https://bench.internal/redwood/bench-4821. Use parenthetical: '(based on internal 48k token/day sim)'. Stat varies by model; recommend wording like 'up to 3–5x throughput at P95 vs baseline'.

Sam K: Inbound routing pseudo: webinar registrants -> nurture; if deployment_choice==Private -> route sales.enterprise; Dedicated -> sales.dedicated; else growth-nurture. Include role-based priority.

Ana R: Action list: Devin finalize copy + banner; Priya add form fields; Sam drafts social + webinar narrative; Chris provides bench note (done). We'll review doc after edits. :thumbsup:

Devin L: On it — will ping when ready for review.

Marketing Bot: Webinar created: https://events.redwood/4821 (ID 4821).

(emoji reactions: Ana R :rocket:, Devin L :white_check_mark:)
